item.title: Kurui no Tsuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jirai Soft
  • 発売日: 2015-12-25
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狂いの月
  • 英語名: Kurui no Tsuki

あらすじ

“I wish to destroy the world.”

“Huh? You’re asking why I want to destroy the world?”

I was born into a prestigious conglomerate family—blessed with wealth, basking in fame, brilliant-minded, strikingly handsome, and not just a refined gentleman but also highly skilled in martial arts. A man of both wisdom and courage.

Not only was I gifted by nature, but I also grew to be broad-minded and magnanimous—truly a perfect being.

item.title: Hotarubi no Shoujo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jirai Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-11-28
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 螢火ノ少女
  • 英語名: Hotarubi no Shoujo

あらすじ

The solitary island of Kyuubi-jima lies in the Sea of Japan. It was named after the legendary nine-tailed fox after a shard of the sesshouseki (killing stone) had reached the island when it died. However, many people left the island to escape from the inauspicious name, and before long the island had its name changed to Hotarubi-jima (light of the fireflies). However, even with its new beautiful name, an ominous shadow still casts over the island.
